mapped_mitigation_patterns: Gate SOC integration on an explicit current-sample validity state.
Cross-check the current input against a redundant sensor or model residual before accumulation.
On invalid input, freeze or bound the estimate and expose the degraded-validity state to consumers.
Propagate invalidBatteryVoltage into PackLimits calculation and transmission eligibility.
Apply a documented conservative fallback or suppress the affected power signal when voltage validity is false.
Carry validity/freshness as an explicit interface contract and test both valid and invalid branches.
Define one explicit unit, scale, initialization, and update invariant for the history value.
Use typed state records that distinguish voltage-derived SOC from counting/history counters.
Add equality, just-below, just-above, reset, and long-run differential tests for the non-default strategy.
Use the state-estimation database SOH record as the single source for both pack and string reporting callbacks.
Specify initialization, unavailable, stale, and range semantics at the SOH interface.
Run end-to-end callback tests with non-100, boundary, and unavailable SOH values.
Represent zero valid temperature samples as an explicit invalid aggregate state.
Do not evaluate thermal SOA with sentinel extrema; hold or degrade the diagnostic state until valid evidence returns.
Require recovery evidence/hysteresis before OK events can decrement or clear an active thermal fatal counter.
MIT-COW-MODE-01: select NORMAL versus CHARGE open-wire enable/period settings using the existing mode discriminator.
MIT-COW-TEST-02: compile and execute target-configuration tests that independently vary NORMAL and CHARGE settings.
Reject or diagnose ambiguous mode/configuration combinations during configuration validation.
Represent diagnostic delays with typed duration constants whose names are generated from or checked against values.
Add compile-time assertions for named-unit/value equality and accepted ranges.
Compile exact configuration rows in unit tests and assert the consumed delay value.
After a close request, transition to a distinct feedback-verification state.
Track progress per string and update the connected-string count only after verified feedback.
Apply a finite deadline with explicit failure/rollback and test every transition edge.
Attach a finite deadline and retry budget to every acknowledgement-wait state.
Transition timeout exhaustion to a defined initialization-error or degraded state.
Test ACK, negative response, dropped response, late response, and retry exhaustion deterministically.
Specify lateness, execution overrun, and their reaction semantics as separate named predicates.
Supervise arrival/alive, execution deadline, and logical control flow independently where required.
Add truth-table tests for neither, each predicate alone, and both predicates together.
Compute the channel index as an integer expression, then enforce an explicit bounds assertion before access.
Reset the detected-wire accumulator independently for each string.
Run single-hot tests for every configured index plus multi-string carry-over cases.
Track validity, timestamp, fragment number, and epoch separately for every fragment.
Commit the aggregate atomically only after all required fragments from one epoch are present.
Invalidate or age out missing members rather than refreshing the whole aggregate header.
Calculate and compare the specified CRC before accepting or storing the payload.
Enforce a documented rolling-counter window with duplicate, replay, jump, and wrap handling.
Reject or mark invalid on integrity failure and raise a separately testable diagnostic.
Create direct tests for every public state request and every internal transition/substate edge.
Maintain a requirements-to-transition-to-test trace matrix including failure and timeout edges.
Measure coverage by configuration variant and investigate each uncovered reachable transition.
Validate manufacturer/model values against a closed schema before generating build state.
Declare every generated configuration input as an explicit build dependency.
Use hermetic clean-build and stale-output differential tests across accepted and rejected configurations.
